controles.affirmation: Rachats d'actions suspendus depuis 2022 pour preserver la notation de credit et la flexibilite financiere ; autorisation residuelle de 1,38 Md$ au 1er mai 2026 ; reprise "au moment approprie" sans date
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q trimestre clos le 1er mai 2026 : "As of May 1, 2026, our common stock repurchase program had a total remaining authorization of approximately $1.38 billion. [...] Although to preserve our investment grade credit rating and maintain financial flexibility we have not repurchased shares under this program since 2022, it remains an important part of our broader capital allocation strategy, and we anticipate resuming share repurchases at the appropriate time."

controles.affirmation: Reglementaire/judiciaire : apres la decision de la Cour supreme du 20 fevrier 2026 invalidant certains tarifs imposes au titre de l'IEEPA, DG a depose des demandes de remboursement aupres des douanes ; calendrier et montant incertains ; environnement tarifaire dynamique
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "Following the February 20, 2026 decision by the United States Supreme Court invalidating certain tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, we submitted claims with U.S. Customs and Border Protection seeking refunds for such tariffs that we previously paid. The exact timing and amount of refunds remain subject to uncertainty." ; "The tariff environment remains dynamic, and the specific tariffs applicable to goods imported by us and our suppliers into the U.S. may continue to evolve."
controles.correction_proposee: Omission favorable a la societe : le meme paragraphe precise "Tariff rates on both direct imports and domestic purchases did not materially impact our financial results for the first quarter of 2026". A ajouter pour equilibrer.

controles.affirmation: Fiscal : expiration du Work Opportunity Tax Credit citee comme facteur susceptible d'alourdir le cout des marchandises vendues et les charges SG&A ; taux d'imposition effectif du T1 2026 a 24,9% contre 23,4% un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K exercice clos le 30 janvier 2026 : "changes in applicable laws and regulations (including tax laws related to the corporate tax rate and the expiration of the Work Opportunity Tax Credit ('WOTC')); and other economic factors, also could impair our ability to successfully execute our strategies and initiatives, as well as increase our cost of goods sold and [SG&A]" ; 10-Q T1 2026 : "The effective income tax rate for the 13-week period ended May 1, 2026 was 24.9% compared to a rate of 23.4% for the 13-week period ended May 2, 2025. The effective income tax rate was higher [...] primarily due to expired federal tax credits"
controles.correction_proposee: La date d'expiration ("fin 2025") n'est pas donnee par les documents cites, qui parlent seulement de "the expiration of the WOTC" et de "expired federal tax credits". Sourcer la date ou l'omettre.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 1 : resultat operationnel de 2,204 Mds$ sur l'exercice clos le 30 janvier 2026, marge de 5,16%, contre 3,328 Mds$ et 8,79% trois ans plus tot, et un point bas de 4,22% sur l'exercice clos fin janvier 2025 ; ecart de 3,6 points
controles.verbatim_source: .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/DG.json, serie operating_income_q : 576,1 + 595,4 + 425,9 + 606,3 = 2 203,7 M$ pour l'exercice clos le 30/01/2026 ; 746,2 + 913,4 + 735,5 + 933,2 = 3 328,3 M$ pour l'exercice precedent de reference ; 546,1 + 550,0 + 323,8 + 294,2 = 1 714,1 M$ pour l'exercice clos le 31/01/2025. 8,79 - 5,16 = 3,63 points.
controles.correction_proposee: Precision de date : l'exercice de reference s'est clos le 3 fevrier 2023, pas "fin janvier 2023".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 2 : notation Baa3 (Moody's) et BBB (Standard & Poor's), perspective stable ; ce sont les echelons LES PLUS BAS de la categorie investment grade
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026, tableau des notations : "Moody's | Baa3 | P-3 | Stable outlook" ; "Standard & Poor's | BBB | A-2 | Stable outlook".
controles.correction_proposee: Baa3 est bien le dernier echelon investment grade chez Moody's, mais BBB n'est PAS le plus bas chez Standard & Poor's : le plancher y est BBB-, soit deux crans sous BBB. Reecrire : "Baa3 est le dernier echelon investment grade chez Moody's ; BBB place la societe deux crans au-dessus du plancher chez Standard & Poor's."

controles.affirmation: La societe avertit qu'elle ne peut garantir maintenir ou ameliorer ses notations si elle ne reduit pas son levier, et cite ses "current increased debt levels" parmi les facteurs de risque sur son profil de credit
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "There can be no assurance that we will maintain or improve our current credit ratings, particularly, if we are unable to lower our leverage ratios to levels and within time frames deemed acceptable to the rating agencies." ; "changes in our credit profile (including our current increased debt levels or any downgrade to our credit ratings)"

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 3 : 4 250 des 4 730 projets immobiliers 2026 sont des remodelings (2 000 Project Renovate + 2 250 Project Elevate) ; capex magasins existants 202,8 M$ (+21,7%), nouveaux magasins 72,7 M$ (-3,8%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "In 2026, we plan to open approximately 450 new stores (as well as approximately 10 stores in Mexico), remodel approximately 2,000 stores through Project Renovate, remodel approximately 2,250 stores through Project Elevate, and relocate approximately 20 stores, for a total of 4,730 real estate projects." ; tableau capex : "Existing stores improvements, upgrades, remodels, and relocations $202.8 / $166.7" ; "New stores primarily for leasehold improvements, fixtures and equipment 72.7 / 75.6"

controles.affirmation: Environ 460 ouvertures NETTES de nouveaux magasins prevues en 2026 (450 aux Etats-Unis et 10 au Mexique)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "we plan to open approximately 450 new stores (as well as approximately 10 stores in Mexico)" - il s'agit d'ouvertures BRUTES. Le meme paragraphe montre que les fermetures ne sont pas nulles : "in the first quarter of 2026 we opened a total of 195 new stores, including 5 stores in Mexico, [...] relocated 6 stores and closed 33 stores."
controles.correction_proposee: Le document ne donne aucun chiffre d'ouvertures nettes. Ecrire "environ 460 ouvertures brutes" et retirer le mot "nettes", ici et dans le ratio "pres de 9 remodelings pour 1 nouvelle ouverture" qui repose sur ce denominateur.

controles.affirmation: Gouvernance : le conseil a approuve le 20 mars 2026 l'embauche de Jerry W. "JJ" Fleeman pour succeder a Todd J. Vasos au poste de DG a compter du 1er janvier 2027 ; Vasos restera conseiller senior jusqu'en avril 2027
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 20 mars 2026 : "On March 20, 2026, the Board of Directors [...] approved the hiring of Jerry W. 'JJ' Fleeman, Jr. to succeed Todd J. Vasos as the Company's Chief Executive Officer ('CEO') expected to be effective as of January 1, 2027 [...] to serve as Senior Advisor, reporting directly to the Chairman of the Board, from the Transition Date through April 2, 2027."

controles.affirmation: Clientele : majorite de clients "value-conscious" a revenus "low and/or fixed" ; SNAP, allocations chomage et aides de relance cites parmi les facteurs macroeconomiques determinants ; clients qui "continue to feel constrained"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "we are mindful that the majority of our customers are value-conscious, and many have low and/or fixed incomes" ; "changes in U.S. government policy and assistance programs (including cost of living adjustments and work requirements), such as SNAP, unemployment benefits, and economic stimulus programs" ; "Our customers continue to feel constrained in the current macroeconomic environment and to experience elevated expenses [...] such as rent, healthcare, energy and fuel prices"

controles.affirmation: Cinq trimestres consecutifs de ventes a magasins comparables positives ; marge brute en hausse de 65 points de base au T1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "same-store sales growth for the last five consecutive quarters" ; "gross profit increased by 5.5%, and as a percentage of net sales increased by 65 basis points to 31.6%"
